query: SELECT baseline, performance_on_NQ, baseline_amount FROM cspaper WHERE (baseline = 'Llama2-7b-Chat; GPT-3.5-turbo' AND performance_on_NQ = 'EM: 36.48; F1: 49.81') OR (evaluation_dataset = 'Custom Agriculture Dataset (USA, Brazil, India); Washington state benchmark dataset' AND generator_model = 'LLama 3.1 8B; Phi-3.5 mini; LLama 3.2 3B; LLaMA 3.2 1B; GPT-4o-mini');
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。
